controls.label: Current Image…
controls.tooltip: The Images window: pick the texture to paint (the paint target)

controls.label: Airbrush
controls.tooltip:
Airbrush · operandi.paint.airbrush
Soft strokes that build up within a stroke, up to Opacity.

controls.label: Paintbrush
controls.tooltip:
Paintbrush · operandi.paint.paintbrush
Solid strokes: overlaps in one stroke don't darken.

controls.label: Eraser
controls.tooltip:
Eraser · operandi.paint.eraser
Lowers alpha; paints the BG colour on images without alpha.

controls.label: Clone
controls.tooltip:
Clone · operandi.paint.clone
Ctrl+click to set the source, then paint to copy from it.

controls.label: Line
controls.tooltip:
Line · operandi.paint.line
Drag a line, circle or rectangle; it goes down on release.

controls.label: Fill
controls.tooltip:
Fill · operandi.paint.fill
Click: every pixel close to that colour takes the FG colour.

controls.label: Linear Gradient
controls.tooltip:
Linear Gradient · operandi.paint.linearGradient
Drag: the image ramps from FG to BG across the line.
Alt+click: Radial Gradient

controls.label: Radial Gradient
controls.tooltip:
Radial Gradient · operandi.paint.radialGradient
Drag from the centre: FG there, BG at the end.

controls.label: Smudge
controls.tooltip:
Smudge · operandi.paint.smudge
Drags the pixels under the brush along the stroke.

controls.label: Blur
controls.tooltip:
Blur · operandi.paint.blur
Softens the pixels under the brush.

controls.label: Sharp
controls.tooltip:
Sharpen · operandi.paint.sharpen
Raises edge contrast under the brush.

controls.label: Lasso
controls.tooltip:
Lasso · operandi.paint.lasso
Draw a shape (left-drag) that limits paint with Use Falloff on.

controls.label: Duplicate Tools
controls.tooltip: Duplicate Tools · coming in a later stage

controls.label: Smooth
controls.tooltip:
Smooth tip · operandi.paint.tip kind:smooth
A soft tip with a shape preset.

controls.label: Hard
controls.tooltip:
Hard tip · operandi.paint.tip kind:hard
A solid core with a soft border.

controls.label: Procedural
controls.tooltip:
Procedural tip · operandi.paint.tip kind:procedural
Strength patterned by noise, cells or dots.

controls.label: Sphere
controls.tooltip:
Sphere tip · operandi.paint.tip kind:sphere
A shaded, rounded dab.

controls.label: Texture
controls.tooltip:
Texture tip · operandi.paint.tip kind:image
A picture is the dab: Normal, Roller or Stamp.

controls.label: Stamp
controls.tooltip:
Stamp tip · operandi.paint.tip kind:stamp
Press the centre, drag for size and angle, release to stamp.

controls.label: Text
controls.tooltip:
Text tip · operandi.paint.tip kind:text
Stamps a text: drag for size and angle.

controls.label: Save Brush Preset
controls.tooltip:
Save Brush Preset · operandi.paint.savePreset
The tip, its values and the nozzle, for any tool.

controls.label: Nozzle
controls.tooltip:
Tablet Nozzle · operandi.paint.nozzle
Pressure, speed, rotation and jitter for the dabs.

controls.label: Image Ink
controls.tooltip:
Image Ink · operandi.paint.ink kind:image
Paints the colours of a picture floating over the view. Click in the view to show it.

controls.label: Parametric Ink
controls.tooltip:
Parametric Ink · operandi.paint.ink kind:parametric
FG to BG (or less paint) by slope, altitude, incidence angle or pressure.

controls.label: Random Ink
controls.tooltip:
Random Ink · operandi.paint.ink kind:random
Each dab's hue, saturation and brightness vary at random.

controls.label: Projection Ink
controls.tooltip:
Projection Ink · operandi.paint.ink kind:projection
Paints the camera's background image, projected from the camera.
